prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_FT_rf', seasonality_champion='NaiveMovingAverage', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ONLY_FT_rf dominates as both trend champion (avg_trend_corr=1.0) and overall champion (avg_rmse=180.49), perfectly tracking the downward trend in both folds. NaiveMovingAverage leads seasonality capture (avg_seasonal_corr=0.417) but has poor overall RMSE (446.34). With rankings_unstable (Kendall τ=-0.04), concept_drift_detected, and high rmse_spread_ratio (2.57), robust combiners like median/trimmed_mean are preferred over stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
